notes.title: End of Early Access ● Patch Note 2.0.0 ● Special Offer ● Wallpaper Giveaway
notes.notes:
Dear beloved community, 

First, we would like to express our gratitude for your love & support for our games. We also owe you an apology. We had ambitious dreams for Hero by Chance II but also made some regrettable mistakes. Our game was plagued with bugs, incorrect translation, unbalanced gameplay, and confusing unlocking features, resulting in a less-than-ideal experience. We deeply regret the frustrations this caused.

Over the past six months, we've been tirelessly listening to your valuable feedback and working hard to turn things around. Your passion for Hero by Chance II and your dedication to helping us improve it inspired us to do better. [b][i]Today, we're thrilled to announce that we are exiting early access and releasing the final version on Steam.[/i][/b]

[u][b]Our Solution and Unwavering Effort:[/b][/u]
👂 [b]Listening to Feedback[/b]: Your voices were heard loud and clear. We read every comment, review, and message sent our way. 
🐞[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We've combed through every inch of the game, eliminating pesky bugs that marred your gaming experience and improving translation accuracy.
⚖️ [b]Rebalanced Gameplay[/b]: The battles you'll face will now be more strategic and satisfying. Your skills will be the determining factor in your victories.
➕[b]New Features and Content[/b]: As a gesture of gratitude for your patience and support over the year, we released a big update, including a new system for special scenes, dating, new units, items, legacy outfits, and more.
🎮[b] We incorporate all these great changes into the DLC Romance & Reprisal, inheriting numerous improvements[/b]: a lighthearted story that concludes our Hero’s first journey, better romance, exciting gameplay features, powerful new units, and an Arena for continued play after completing the main story.
💕Amidst the current economic situation, we understand your circumstances and remain devoted to affordable price points for our games. This commitment reflects our gratitude for your feedback and support. Join hands with us to build better games and a stronger community.

🔥 As we've mentioned, you can now [u]get Hero by Chance II with 40% off[/u] from today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627680/Love_n_War_Hero_by_Chance_II/

notes.title: ⚙️ Patch Note 1.6.0 ⚙️
notes.notes:
After carefully observing the feedback from the community, this quick update will help you get the achievements more easily. Some bugs and balance issues have been fixed, along with some exciting improvements to enhance the combat experience.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the card drop rate so you can get them more easily.
[*] Fixed the issue of repeated conversation in Cecilia and Tyra's special scene.
[*] Fixed some Chinese text errors or incorrect character names.
[*] Fixed the bug in the Merge and Fusion tutorial that caused a gold shortage and got players stuck.
[*] Cecilia's dating 2 now appears correctly in Chapter 8-6.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements:
[/h3][list]
[*] Renee's combat skill can now destroy a random enemy tower.
[*] Improved the effectiveness and clarity of Tia's combat skill.
[*] Increase the duration of Grete's tactical skill.
[/list]
[h3]Game Balances:
[/h3][list]
[*] In the main game, normal mode from Chapter 3 to 9 has slightly reduced enemy troops, while DP and SP in battles have been slightly increased.
[*] Siege battles: Increased damage and reduced health of catapults, significantly reduced the number of enemy troops flooding in when the walls are breached.
[*] DLC: Reduced the damage of the enemy Assassin General to avoid unexpected deaths of your generals.
[*] Increased the health of Knight generals to make them more effective on the battlefield.
[/list]
And other minor bug fixes.

We have recently received some constructive negative reviews regarding the challenges present in both the main game and DLC. We understand the concerns and have encountered difficulties while addressing these adjustments. We kindly request your continued feedback to help us create a game that captivates and engages as many players as possible. ❤️

The Arena mode in the DLC [b]Romance & Reprisal[/b] has shown great potential, and we are considering adding stages 51 to 100 as well as developing them in [b]Warlord by Chance II[/b]. How do you feel about this? Leave your comments below!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - Patch note 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Now is the time to indulge in romantic moments with Cecilia and Tyra, as well as experience the refreshing new content filled with lighthearted humor and significantly enhanced special scenes. 💕

Don't forget to share your feedback with us, so we can continue to improve our products and offer you the best gaming experience possible. ❤️

[h3]1. New Features
[/h3]- Cecilia and Tyra’s dating features: unlocked after chapters 1-2, 2-7, 6-6, and 8-6. You can use save 9-9 to directly access the dating scenes on the Replay screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/54df37f560ba5522789dd16423035ca77dd89451.jpg[/img]
[i]Dating scenes
[/i]
- New special scenes: unlocked Tyra’s new scene after 4-8 and Cecilia’s one after 8-6 (accessed via the Gallery, click on the top heart icon). 

- Shop features: purchase and sell equipment, gems, gifts, and legacy outfits for your ladies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/eadfbbdb4f880e9b6c69a7655de3eb418c5fa042.jpg[/img]
[i]Shop features
[/i]
- New druid unit: Collect elite equipment in Chapters 8-8 and 9-2.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/1ad89945489d684029b2b77adb9debdccb594605.png[/img]
[i]Druid unit
[/i]
- Affection level: reduces skill cost in battles for generals. It is increased by dating or giving gifts to the ladies. Gifts can be purchased in the shop or collected in battles.

[h3]2. Improvements:
[/h3]Deployable General’s regular attacks have been improved:
+ Generals with warrior class have a chance to stun and push back enemies, having a certain area of effect.
+ Generals with Mage class can cause explosions and damage all enemies within a certain radius.
+ Assassin Lydia remains unchanged with her single-target attacks.
+ You can now recall your Generals after you deploy them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/3a0600efef9fd6a4219f086e66998855eb95918f.gif[/img]

- Siege battles have been rebalanced for a more intense and enjoyable experience true to its nature.
- Monsters and Dragons have been reclassified as Beasts. Beast and Mage are two classes that will deal 50% extra damage to each other. A new unit counter chart can be viewed during battles.
- Sorting units: you can now re-arrange your unit bar in battles. Simple drag and drop a unit to a desired order.
- To enhance the story's depth further, there are additional dialogs between you and enemy lieutenants at the moment they are captured.

[h3]3. Game Balances:
[/h3]- The difficulty has been slightly adjusted in normal mode and hard mode is now more challenging.
- You receive more gold in the first three chapters to help with your upgrades.
- Some units’ deployment points have been adjusted.

And other performances, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements are done in this patch note.

🌟 There are also seven new achievements in this update.
